novelty.justification: The claim’s distinctive route is a mechanism-sensitive measurement in which “replacing the substrate with a therapeutically-equivalent drug metabolized by a DIFFERENT enzyme” should remove an internal DDI signal while a “structure-changing control swap that keeps the SAME enzyme” preserves it, supplemented by a recovered shared-enzyme steering direction. Searches under “foundation model internal representations CYP450 drug-drug interaction mechanistic interpretability,” “CYP enzyme swap counterfactual DDI language model,” and “drug foundation model shared enzyme activation steering” found adjacent CYP prediction work such as Li et al., “In Silico Prediction of Cytochrome P450-Drug Interaction” (2016), and generic causal-representation precedents such as RAVEL (Huang et al., 2024), but no equivalent test of off-the-shelf drug or medical foundation-model representations using CYP-bypass counterfactuals. The step is best classified as a substantive multi-step adaptation and operationalization—not merely a renamed probe, but also not a new interpretability paradigm—because established probing, counterfactual controls, and activation steering are combined around a newly defined pharmacological contrast rather than a new core intervention principle.
